1. (Currently amended) A control system comprising: a controller including a processor and memory, wherein the controller is communicatively coupled to automation components in the control system and facilitates performance of a process through interoperation with the automation components, the controller comprising: a model determination module stored in the memory and executable by the processor to determine a model configured to describe the process; an input/output variable determination module stored in the memory and executable by the processor to determine input and output variables of the process; a constraint determination module stored in the memory and executable by the processor to determine constraints on the input and output variables; an objective function determination module stored in the memory and executable by the processor to determine an objective function associated with the process; and a holistic state data generation module stored in the memory and executable by the processor to generate holistic state data by storing the model, the input and output variables, the constraints, and the objective function in one of a plurality of fields in the holistic state data, wherein the holistic state data enables the automation components to detect and operate with the controller upon receiving the holistic state data.

2. (Currently amended) The control system of claim 1, wherein the controller is communicatively coupled to the automation components via a communication network and communicates the holistic state data to each of the automation components upon connecting to the communication network.

3. (Currently amended) The control system of claim 1, wherein the controller is communicatively coupled to the automation components via a backplane and communicates the holistic state data to the automation components upon connecting to the backplane.

4. (Original) The control system of claim 1, wherein the holistic state data is a standardized format understood by each of the automation components.

5. (Currently amended) The control system of claim 1, wherein the holistic state data generation module stores an intermediate search result of an optimization search and a state of the optimization search when the intermediate search result is determined in an optimization state field of the holistic state data.

6. (Currently amended) The control system of claim 1, wherein the holistic state data generation module generates the holistic state data to facilitate performing an optimization search in conjunction with one or more of the automation components in the control system.

7. (Currently amended) The control system of claim 1, wherein the holistic state data generation module stores computational capabilities of the controller and interconnections with the automation components in the control system in a controller settings field of the holistic state data.

8. (Currently amended) The control system of claim 1, wherein the controller communicates the holistic state data to a server in the control system to facilitate determining an optimization problem.

9. (Currently amended) The control system of claim 1, wherein the memory comprises an in-memory database configured to store the holistic state data.

10. (Currently amended) A tangible, non-transitory computer-readable medium configured to store instructions executable by a processor of a controller, wherein the instructions comprise: a configuration data reception module configured to receive control system configuration data; an automation component determination module configured to determine automation components communicatively coupled to the controller and characteristics of the automation components based at least in part on the control system configuration data; an optimization problem determination module configured to determine an optimization problem based at least in part on the automation components and the characteristics of each of the automation components; and a control action instruction module configured to instruct one or more of the automation components to perform a control action in a process, wherein the control action is determined based at least in part on the optimization problem.

11. (Currently amended) The computer-readable medium of claim 10, wherein the characteristics of each of the automation components comprise a model used by the automation component, and the optimization problem determination module determines the optimization problem based at least in part on the model used by each of the automation components.

12. (Currently amended) The computer-readable medium of claim 10, wherein the characteristics of each of the automation components comprise a computing capability of the automation component, and the optimization problem determination module determines the optimization problem based at least in part on computing compatibilities of each of the automation components.

13. (Currently amended) The computer-readable medium of claim 10, wherein the control system configuration data comprises a plurality of holistic state data, wherein each of the plurality of holistic state data corresponds with one of the automation components.

14. (Currently amended) The computer-readable medium of claim 13, wherein the automation component determination module parses each of the plurality of holistic state data.

15. (Original) The computer-readable medium of claim 13, wherein each of the plurality of holistic state data comprises a standardized format with same fields.

16. (Currently amended) The computer-readable medium of claim 10, wherein the configuration data reception module receives the configuration data from a cloud.

17. (Currently amended) A method for performing diagnostics on a control system comprising: determining, using a processor, holistic state data captured by a controller in the control system, wherein the holistic state data includes a model describing a process, input and output variables of the process, constraints on the input and output variables, and an objective function associated with the process; simulating, using the processor and a simulation module, operation of the controller based at least in part on the holistic state data while the controller performs other operations; analyzing, using the processor and an analysis module, the simulation of the controller to perform diagnostics on the controller; and adjusting, using the processor, operation of the control system based at least in part on the diagnostics.

18. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17, wherein: the simulation module simulates performance of various control actions by the controller; and the analysis module analyzes results of the various control actions.

19. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17, wherein the analysis module analyzes the simulation by: determining a predicted response to a control action determined by the controller using a model; and comparing the predicted result with an actual response to the control action to determine accuracy of the model.

20. (Currently amended) The method of claim 19, comprising adjusting, using the processor, the model when the predicted response and the actual response vary.
